scripts.text: There is no way to find out what the state of the repeater is. The communication chip seems to be properly installed.
scripts.translation: 無法查明中繼器的狀態。通訊晶片似乎已正確安裝。

scripts.text: You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續領取。請清理背包、減輕負重後再試。^000000

scripts.text: The body of Manager Beta is hidden under the landscapes.
scripts.translation: 貝塔管理員的軀體藏在庭園景物下面。

scripts.text: I'll let Alpha know later so she can retrieve the doll's body.
scripts.translation: 之後我會通知阿爾法，讓她來取回人偶的軀體。
